==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

[[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] lays on her bed, worrying over what will happen to her. She talks to [[Elayne]] through the hole in the wall. Elayne had not expected this reception. Egwene agrees, as she had thought they might be heroes for discovering the Black Ajah and that [[Liandrin]] is one of them. They also returned with the [[Horn of Valere]]. But [[Verin Mathwin|Verin]] had said that they cannot speak of Liandrin or the Horn to anyone but the Amyrlin. Both Verin and [[Faolain Orande|Faolain]] had mentioned [[Severing#Stilling|Stilling]] as a possible punishment; the two agree that they would fight or run away before they let that happen. Their doors slam open and [[Accepted]] come to take them to the [[Siuan|Amyrlin]].



Egwene and Elyane meet up with [[Nynaeve]] who is also on her way to see the Amyrlin. [[Faolain Orande|Faolain]] tries to criticize Egwene in front of [[Leane Sharif|Leane]] in the antechamber but only earns herself a punishment. Leane escorts them in to see the Amyrlin who makes them wait before eventually addressing them. Siuan calls them runaways but Nynaeve immediately disagrees and says that they were only following Liandrin's orders to go with her. Siuan says not to speak her name here. Elayne says Liandrin is Black Ajah but Siuan already knows. Liandrin and twelve others stole several ''[[ter'angreal]]'' from the Tower and tried to steal ''[[angreal]]'' and ''[[sa'angreal]]''. They also killed twenty-one people including three [[Aes Sedai]] to hide their theft and escape. Even though they were tricked into leaving without permission, they are to be sent to [[Sheriam]] for a sound switching and they will work in the kitchens until further notice. The punishments are to be announced publicly which is also part of the punishment.

However, Egwene and Elayne will be raised to [[Accepted]] because their abilities have greatly increased. Elayne's mother visited the Tower and was furious to learn that Elayne had disappeared. She refused to take [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]], normally her advisor, back with her to [[Caemlyn]] and demanded that Elayne be returned as soon as possible. Elayne's brothers talked themselves into staying when [[Morgase Trakand|Morgase]] wanted to leave with them. Morgase left a letter with Sheriam for Elayne; Elayne replies that she wishes to stay and become [[Aes Sedai]]. Siuan agrees and is determined to see her raised to the shawl. Siuan has Leane take Elayne to the kitchens so she can talk to Egwene and Nynaeve in private.
